title: Gas through jelly
hook: An egg can have a covering without a hard shell.

knows: Animals have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The arrows show oxygen moving from surrounding water through the schematic egg layers toward the embryo. Amphibian eggs vary, and the drawing does not show rates or all membranes.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: In the simplified aquatic egg shown, how can oxygen reach the developing embryo?
